items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When Rufus joined it was Howard, Rufus, John Purcell and David Murray.

ctx.x: When Rufus joined it was Howard, Rufus, John Purcell and David Murray. I wrote for that group using some electric drum machines and synthesizers. I did something called, “The New Orleans Strut,” which was really nice and I recorded it again on an album with… It was “Pretty Boy” Purdie’s record. He and I both played drums on
it. Junior Mance is on piano. We’d have to research it. I have a copy of it upstairs.
